Success and bonuses will be measured not simply by getting the job done, but by delivering products on time and at the quality level required by the company. We’re a creative, fashion- and trend-driven business, and we like to challenge the way things have always been done. Our patented 1LENS technology represents a breakthrough in eyewear design and has the potential to establish an entirely new benchmark for the category, an innovation unlike anything the industry has seen in generations. We’re looking for people who are energized by that kind of thinking: people who are curious, creative, entrepreneurial, willing to challenge conventional wisdom, and excited to turn ideas into products and products into successful businesses. If you like solving problems, moving fast, creating something new, and having a meaningful impact, you’ll fit right in. And while we’re serious about building a successful business, we believe success should have a bigger purpose. Through our global “We See You” program, Fortress helps provide the gift of sight to people in need around the world. It’s a simple idea that reflects who we are: see opportunity, create something great, and help others see a little better along the way.   Come see what’s possible at Fortress. Coordinate purchase orders, vendor communications, and supplier relationships. Assist with negotiating payment terms. Communicate daily with domestic and international manufacturing partners. Coordinate chargebacks related to discrepancies, quality concerns, or delivery issues. Coordinate all phases of product development from concept through production approval. Manage prototype development, sample reviews, revisions, and approvals. Coordinate product retail pricing and assets, packaging, labeling, artwork, and product specifications. Ensure new products meet Fortress quality and brand standards. Maintain an organized product sample library and warehouse sample area. Identify opportunities for product improvements and innovation. Coordinate product launch timelines with Finance, Sales and Marketing. Prepare product information for customer presentations. Support key customer presentations and new product introductions. Sales & Executive Support Work closely with the CEO and General Manager on product development priorities. Support product initiatives and special projects. Collaborate with Sales and Customer Service to meet customer product requirements. Experience with QuickBooks or similar software and the ability to understand and work confidently with product costs, margins and purchase orders. Demonstrated ability to work with product specifications, samples, materials, costing, production schedules, quality standards, and product launches. A sense of ownership, accountability, and urgency, and the ability to identify problems and opportunities before they become issues. Creative, resourceful problem-solver who challenges conventional thinking and develops practical solutions rather than waiting for direction. Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple products, projects, vendors, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously. Competent and comfortable working across both Apple and PC hardware and software environments. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where priorities can change and individual initiative is highly valued. Preferred Qualification Experience supporting or managing overseas manufacturing partners and factory relationships, particularly in Asia. Experience in eyewear, fashion accessories, apparel, sporting goods, action sports, outdoor, or other fashion- and trend-driven consumer products. Experience with inventory forecasting, demand planning, and managing fashion-related inventory risk. Experience managing private-label programs and/or multiple consumer brands for wholesale retail customers. Compensation & Benefits Base salary: $65,000 - $75,000 DOE. Up to 50% Annual Performance Bonus paid on quarterly results. Total compensation could reach $$97,500 - $112,500. Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits. Paid Time Off (PTO). Paid holidays. Why This Role Is a Great Opportunity This is not a role for someone who simply wants to manage a list of responsibilities or a team of people to do the work for them. It’s an opportunity for a self-motivated person to make things happen, take ownership, and see the results of their work. At Fortress, your ideas can become products, your solutions can change the way we do business, and your accomplishments will be visible. Make a real impact. Work directly with the CEO and company leadership and have a meaningful voice in production, supply chain, inventory, product development and the growth of the business. Think like an entrepreneur. Take ownership, make decisions, pursue opportunities, and manage your responsibilities. Create and innovate. Help develop products and ideas that challenge the status quo, create excitement in the marketplace, and have the potential to disrupt established categories. Be a courageous, calm problem solver. Things don’t always go according to plan. We value people who stay composed, think creatively, find solutions, and move forward rather than waiting for someone else to fix the problem. T ake pride in accomplishment. You’ll have the opportunity to point to tangible results—successful products, better costs, stronger margins, on-time production, healthy inventory, and improved business performance—and know that you helped make them happen. Grow with the company. Fortress is a growing national consumer products business with multiple brands, wholesale channels, and significant opportunities ahead. The person in this role can grow as the company grows. Have fun doing it. We’re in a fashion- and trend-driven business built around creativity, innovation, and helping people see the world a little differently. We work hard, but we believe business should be exciting and rewarding. If you’re energized by opportunity, take pride in what you accomplish, and would rather create solutions than wait for instructions, we’d like to meet you. Come see what’s possible at Fortress.
